item.title: Jackson Pollock Music Video
item.description: Had a blast making this music video with my friend Mika, my partner Emma, and some wonderful friends recently. Follow the mishaps, trials and travails of our adventurer, Mika, as they try their best to enjoy a fun summer day in Seattle. Along the way, a mysterious wizard intervenes to help them out...

item.title: House Show August 22nd
item.description: I'll be playing a show with Johnny and John on Friday, August 22nd at the Shelby House (1208 E Shelby St)—A Grebes Trio for the first time ever! There is a new Grebes music video in the works, and we're planning to premiere it at the show as well! Emma (flowering ground) is going to be playing too, plus an artist visiting from L.A. named Albon. Should be really fun! Hope to see you there :)

item.title: Why make a website?
item.description:
One of the conundrums of making art these days seems to be sharing it in a way that feels good. Instagram has become the go-to platform for musicians and other artists to share their work, connect with other artists, promote shows, and so on. But much of this sense of "growing an audience" is illusory. Interactions on Instagram aren't very intentional, and the platform is designed to keep users scrolling through ads rather than thoughtfully spending time with someone's content.

I would love to live in a world where music and art are shared through community networks that aren't owned by mega-corporations. Mostly it comes down to being intentional about the art and music we engage with. One of my own small acts was to make this website! I'll still use email and Instagram from time to time, but I'm curious to explore sharing my music in a space that is my own, without ads or tracking.
